dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with a moderate pixel radius, forming the transition between a near-linear leading edge and a concave trailing edge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep anterior margin contour at approximately 65 degrees relative to the longitudinal body axis, with a slight basal convexity.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The dorsal fin exhibits a width-to-height ratio of approximately 1.3:1 based on visible pixel boundaries.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: The melon presents a smooth, medium-radius convex arc transitioning smoothly from the blowhole region towards the rostrum.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short and robust rostrum with a high thickness-to-length ratio, extending approximately 0.4 times the total cranial length.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle of approximately 155 degrees at the pixel coordinate where the descending melon slope meets the dorsal rostrum base.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced dark-toned dorsal cape with a distinct ventral dip beneath the dorsal fin area, contrasting against the lighter lateral coloration.
